noveltyJustification: Compared validator result statuses with outer CLI exit semantics and capability defaults, exposing a freshness error path that exits zero, a nonblocking completion-status mismatch, opt-in continuity skips, and indistinguishable validation bypasses.

ruledOut.approach: Promote every fail-open route or dispatch guard into a decommission completion finding
ruledOut.reason: Those modules own advisory routing and command dispatch, not the spec validator verdict

edgeCase: error-versus-stale exit semantics and opt-in skips

title: Dist-freshness error status can exit zero and be invisible to validate.sh
evidence: [INFERENCE: an error result that exits 0 is invisible to the caller and can leave a stale-but-runnable compiled gate as the apparent authority]
smallestFix: Return a dedicated nonzero code for freshness status=error and make validate.sh stop rather than continue.

title: Generated complete status can pass while completion evidence disagrees
smallestFix: Enforce status/completion consistency for decommission packets or graduate the default and require explicit legacy waivers.

title: Continuity freshness is opt-in and missing evidence returns a pass-style skip
smallestFix: Make skipped/not-applicable distinct from success and require usable continuity evidence for completion claims.

title: Validation bypasses and missing completion sections return zero
smallestFix: Emit a machine-readable skipped status and require an explicit waiver before callers treat it as completion proof.
